title: Enable Prompt Caching 1H (ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H=1)
reason: Explicitly guarantees 1-hour prompt cache TTL for all Claude Code sessions. Fixes silent bug where DISABLE_TELEMETRY users were silently getting 5-min TTL instead of 1hr. Makes cache TTL explicit and reliable rather than implicit. Official Anthropic v2.1.108 feature.
debug_var: FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M=1 — forces 5-min TTL for testing cache expiry behavior
